hooks.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit'; then output=$(./mvnw compile -q 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then safe=$(echo "$output" | head -20 | tr '"' '`' | tr '\n' ' '); printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Compilacion fallida. Corrige los errores antes de commitear: %s"}' "$safe"; exit 0; fi; fi

input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit'; then staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- '*.java' 2>/dev/null | head -50); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then violations=$(echo "$staged" | xargs grep -l 'System\.out\.print' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$violations" ]; then files=$(echo "$violations" | tr '\n' ' '); printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"System.out.println encontrado en archivos staged: %s Elimina el debug output antes de commitear."}' "$files"; exit 0; fi; fi; fi
